subject: Psychology
central_question: How do groups form and develop, what structures and identities organise them, and how does group presence influence individual performance and judgment?

known_pitfalls.claim: Any collection of people is a group.
known_pitfalls.correction: A group requires organised interaction, identity, common motives, roles, norms and interdependence.

known_pitfalls.claim: Working in a group always increases individual effort.
known_pitfalls.correction: Pooled, unidentifiable contributions may produce social loafing.

recommended_example_progression: NCERT Activity 7.2 and Box 7.2: analyse ingroup favouritism.
Noise study and tug-of-war: explain social loafing.
NCERT Review Questions 4–5: analyse group influence and reduce loafing.
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: The end-of-chapter Review Questions contain Questions 1–5, followed by one Project Idea.
